playoff.note: single match at the Pro League club's ground; bottom club relegated directly
1st and 2nd promoted directly; the play-off is hosted by the Pro League club

boundaries.note: Pro League 1st and 2nd up directly, 3rd into a single play-off at home against the Super League 12th; Super League bottom down directly. Counts flex: the Super League article says two or three clubs can be relegated, and promotion is voided if a reserve side wins the Pro League.

conflicts.note: 14 is correct for 2026 (the season article lists 14 clubs and 182 matches) but the league's own infobox and lead sentence still say 6. A row copied from last season would say 6 - and 14 clubs means 26 rounds, not 10.

conflicts.real: 2-3 depending on the season, plus a one-off 2026 reshape
conflicts.note: The Pro League article describes bottom-club-down plus a 12th-v-3rd play-off; the 2026 Super League table instead marks 12th-15th as play-off places and 16th as direct relegation. Treat the 2026 markings as an unexplained one-off and implement the documented rule.

conflicts.real: last club down per the rule; the 2026 table marks 13th and 14th
conflicts.note: The regulations text says the last-placed club is relegated to the First League; the 2026 standings mark two places. Level 3 (First League) is not in our rows either way.

notes: Calendar-year season, March-November. Super League 16 clubs / 30 rounds; Pro League 14 clubs / 26 rounds in 2026 after shrinking to 6 in 2024-25, so the 14 is new and the Pro League's own article has not caught up. Promotion is 2 direct + 1 single-match play-off hosted by the second-tier club; the Super League bottom club goes down. Reserve teams may not be promoted to the top flight, and a reserve champion voids a promotion place, so the up-count can fall to 2. UZ2L is closed_down only because the First League (level 3) is not in our rows.
